title: Graylog Extended Log Format (GELF)

fields.name: compress
fields.description: If transport protocol is udp, set this to compress UDP packets.

fields.name: gelf_full_message_key
fields.description: Key to use as the long message that can, for example, contain a backtrace. Optional in GELF.

fields.name: gelf_host_key
fields.description: Key whose value is used as the name of the host, source, or application that sent this message. Must be set in GELF.

fields.name: gelf_level_key
fields.description: Key to be used as the log level. Its value must be in standard syslog levels (between 0 and 7). Optional in GELF.

fields.name: gelf_short_message_key
fields.description: A short descriptive message. Must be set in GELF.

fields.name: gelf_tag_key
fields.description: Key to be used for tag. Optional in GELF.

fields.name: gelf_timestamp_key
fields.description: Your log timestamp. This should be set in GELF.

fields.name: host
fields.description: IP address or hostname of the target Graylog server.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Pattern to match which tags of logs to be sent by this plugin.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: The protocol to use. Allowed values: tls, tcp, udp.

fields.name: packet_size
fields.description: If transport protocol is udp, you can set the size of packets to be sent.

fields.name: port
fields.description: The port that your Graylog GELF input is listening on.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Fluent Bit output plugin: Graylog Extended Log Format (GELF).
